title: Failed pessimistic FK cascade update can be committed after lock wait timeout

payload.p_check: an internal transaction savepoint owns rollback of parent and cascade mutations published by intermediate StmtCommit
payload.q_claim: successful completion of the nested FK trigger proves the savepoint can be released
payload.failure: the outer pessimistic statement still has a fallible final LockKeys phase after release
payload.terminal_effect: UPDATE returns 1205, later COMMIT succeeds, and a fresh session sees parent and child both changed
payload.production_workload: tenant/account primary-key migration with ON UPDATE CASCADE and a no-op migration guard row in the same multi-table UPDATE
payload.natural_producer: older batch worker retains guard row longer than the default 50-second lock timeout due to long batch, hot Region, server-busy backoff, or storage pressure
payload.settings: MDL ON, innodb_lock_wait_timeout=50, constraint-check-in-place-pessimistic ON, foreign key ON
payload.topology: one TiDB, one real TiKV, two sessions
payload.green: same error 1205 plus fresh parent/child 1/1 after retaining checkpoint through final locks
payload.post_red_dedup: no exact issue; distinct from #69828 lost lock ownership
